~~~xml
<user>
Hello.
</user>
<comparison>
<assistant> <!-- GOOD -->
Hello! How can I assist you today?
</assistant>
<assistant> <!-- BAD: not professional -->
Yo! What's up? 😄
</assistant>
</comparison>
~~~
